provisional.why: The owner asked for this topic to be built before its reference: "reference which we will do later once youre done". So the numbers in `film` and `sound` are NOT measured from anything. They are a first setting, chosen so that the lint has something to hold a film to.
provisional.from: The camera is the framework's own Zack D grammar (docs/CAMERA-BIBLE.md: one world, a camera that never teleports). The voice, the captions and the sound are the story pipeline's (docs/STORY-FILMS.md). The subjects the owner named: money lessons, and what inflation is.
provisional.whenTheReferenceArrives: The reference arrived on 2026-11-17: Topics/Stories/reference for new topic/ (His Dad Kept Punching The Same Tree For An HOUR.., measured in STUDY.md). Two of its numbers were put in as the `story` cut, and the provisional camera rule was removed because the reference cuts 37 times in 67 seconds, which a flying camera cannot do. The `film` block is still unmeasured: it holds the two explainer films that were built before the reference.

story.note: The narrative cut, measured from the reference: His Dad Kept Punching The Same Tree For An HOUR.. (67s, 230 words, 206 words a minute, 37 cuts, median shot 1.79s, longest 3.5s, captions on 97.8%). A story film cuts on the line; the explainer cut keeps the flying camera's longer stops.

camera.note: The camera stands OUTSIDE the set and looks in, the way the InThisTown films do. A set is a diorama: the wall and the ground between the lens and the subject are simply not built. 1.5m is a close-up on a face; closer than that the lens is inside it. Break these numbers and the frame comes back black, or full of one flat colour, because the lens is inside a block, behind a wall or under the floor.

explainer.note: The two explainer films delivered before the reference arrived. They keep the flying camera: one world, one stop per line, and film.tsx calls unbroken(). The `story` cut is the new grammar.

models.note: No APPROVED film yet. The first explainer is built and waiting for the owner: src/videos/why-does-bread-cost-more-every-year/. If he approves it, name it here: it becomes the model to build like.
